Quick answers up front:
- Proposed scope: Hosted API (public) + Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity). We recommend excluding Private/on-prem for initial intake unless you explicitly require it; that adds complexity and separate attestation.
- Deliverables we will upload to the Drive folder you provide: scope_matrix_v1.xlsx (scope/instance mapping), caiq_crosswalk_v1.pdf (control-to-owner crosswalk), telemetry_extract_sample.csv (redacted sample).
- Proposed cadence: preliminary package by 2027-06-18, final by 2027-06-23 to give you time for ingestion.

Kimberly (cc) will validate the telemetry schema and confirm retention windows. Marissa will own the upload and the artifact manifest.

If that plan works I'll send the Drive link and a short checklist for fields we will include in the extract. Happy to hop on a 30m call Thursday afternoon if you want to go line-by-line.

Telemetry extract guidance (we will provide a redacted CSV sample):

Please confirm if Paragon needs full headers or a summarized header fieldset (we can provide both but full headers require an exemption).

I attached a quick draft sample and the crosswalk PDF for control owner mapping (caiq_crosswalk_v1.pdf). We'll sanitize tenant ids before sending.
